name: 28_foward_collision_warning_mouse_as_joystick
description: Collision Warning Scenario with LFS in Wheel/Joystick mode. Vjoy needs to brake with virtual axes, Setting the brake to a Keyboard key is not possible in this mode. Difference to a normal racing Wheel: lfs uses a combined brake/throttle axis in this Scenario. The user Needs to set this in the Settings and then the addon Needs to brake correctly. More difficult Scenario with steering and a bit of Manual braking.
preconditions: LFS is running with InSim enabled on port 29999
LFS is at the main menu
